info.name: AryaSDR APIs
info.description:
Auto-generated collection of every AryaSDR API endpoint (Next.js App Router).

## Setup

1. Set `{{base_url}}` — defaults to `https://aryasdr.in`. Point at `http://localhost:3000` for local dev.
2. Set `{{token}}` — a Clerk-issued JWT for the signed-in user. Fastest way to grab one: sign in on `{{base_url}}`, open DevTools console, run:

   ```js
   window.Clerk.session.getToken().then(t => { console.log(t); navigator.clipboard.writeText(t) })
   ```

   Paste as the `token` variable. Tokens expire in ~60s; call `getToken()` again when needed.

## Auth model

- `clerk_session` requests attach `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.
- `webhook_signature` requests (Clerk `user.created` webhook) require svix headers — leave these to Clerk itself in production; use Clerk Dashboard → Webhooks → Send Test Event to fire them.
- `public` requests need no auth (`/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/integrations/gmail` start).

## Path variables

Endpoints like `/api/campaigns/:id` use Postman path variables. Fill in the `id` under the request's Params → Path Variables tab, or use the pre-populated sample UUID.
